description: This file defines an interface 'EndpointAwareReport' within the OrangeHRM system, which extends the 'Report' interface and adds methods related to preparing filter parameters, validation rules, and access control for reports tied to specific API endpoints.

classes.name: EndpointAwareReport
classes.description: An interface extending 'Report' that stipulates methods for preparing filter parameters, obtaining validation rules, and checking report access permissions tied to specific API endpoints.

methods.name: prepareFilterParams
methods.description: Constructs and returns a FilterParams object based on the provided EndpointProxy, representing the specific filtering criteria for the report.

methods.name: getValidationRule
methods.description: Returns a collection of validation rules (ParamRuleCollection) for validating parameters passed to the report endpoint.

methods.name: checkReportAccessibility
methods.description: Checks if the report is accessible via the given endpoint and throws a ForbiddenException if access is denied.
